resources.string: One tap makes an Anki card: the word, its reading and definition, the sentence it is in, the sound of that sentence, and a picture of the screen. From SubRead Overlay, from the text selection menu of any app, from the share sheet, or from a web page.
Nothing leaves the device. The app talks to AnkiDroid, SubRead Overlay and SubRead Dictionary on the device. It opens a URL only when a sender gives one for an audio or a picture.
AnkiDroid is not installed. The app adds the cards to it.
Allow the app to add cards to AnkiDroid. If AnkiDroid refuses, turn on "Enable AnkiDroid API" in its settings, under Advanced.
The name of the new deck
Note type: %1$s (the app makes it in AnkiDroid)
What goes into each field of the note type. The app guesses from the names; Lapis and the basic note types work as they are.
SubRead Overlay is installed. In its settings, choose "Anki" as the dictionary: a tap on a word of the subtitle line makes the card, with the line as the sentence and its sound.
SubRead Overlay is not installed. With it, a tap on a word of the subtitle line makes the card, with the line as the sentence and its sound.
SubRead Dictionary is installed: it gives the reading, the definition, the pitch, the frequency and the word audio.
SubRead Dictionary is installed, but this version does not answer other apps. Update it for the definitions.
SubRead Dictionary is not installed. Without it, a card has no definition unless the sender gives one.

The sound of the player and a picture of the screen go on the card while the capture is on. Android asks each time it starts. The quick settings have a tile for it. A player that hides its sound (DRM) gives no sound.
This Android version captures the screen only; the sound of other apps needs Android 10.
Capturing the sound and the screen for the cards
Android did not allow the capture.
The capture needs the microphone permission of Android, for the sound of the player. No microphone is recorded.
Sound before and after the line, in milliseconds
Ask before adding: off (one tap adds)
A word that is in the deck already: skip
A word that is in the deck already: add again
After the card, open SubRead Dictionary: on
After the card, open SubRead Dictionary: off
The request is empty: no word and no sentence.
Anki did not take the card: %1$s
Picture added to the last card
No card of the last hour to add the picture to
